computed.hit: contains(vars.deploy_text, 'hubble') or contains(vars.deploy_text, 'typha') or contains(vars.deploy_text, 'flowlog') or contains(vars.deploy_text, 'flow-log')
computed.state: if(not vars.hit, 'absent', if(not vars.driver_ok or vars.forced_degraded, 'degraded', 'deployed'))
computed.hardening: if(vars.state == 'absent', ['rule:product=netobserv:state=absent:category=deployment:建议=未检出 网络可视化(Hubble/Calico flows)——确认是否需要部署；当前技术类别矩阵全盲区'], concat(if(vars.state == 'degraded', ['rule:product=netobserv:state=degraded:category=kernel-state:建议=恢复内核态/健康组件（缺失: ' + vars.missing_driver + '）；降级期间内核态依赖技术全部视为盲区'], []), map(filter(vars.techniques, not ((vars.state == 'deployed' or (vars.state == 'degraded' and not it.needs_driver)) and it.detected and (steps.ruleset.exists != true or contains(steps.ruleset.json.rules, it.id)))), 'rule:product=netobserv:technique=' + it.id + ':state=' + vars.state + ':category=' + it.category + ':建议=' + it.gap)))
computed.detected_count: count_if(vars.techniques, (vars.state == 'deployed' or (vars.state == 'degraded' and not it.needs_driver)) and it.detected and (steps.ruleset.exists != true or contains(steps.ruleset.json.rules, it.id)))
computed.blindspot_count: count_if(vars.techniques, not ((vars.state == 'deployed' or (vars.state == 'degraded' and not it.needs_driver)) and it.detected and (steps.ruleset.exists != true or contains(steps.ruleset.json.rules, it.id))))

fields.detected: map(filter(vars.techniques, (vars.state == 'deployed' or (vars.state == 'degraded' and not it.needs_driver)) and it.detected and (steps.ruleset.exists != true or contains(steps.ruleset.json.rules, it.id))), it.id)
fields.blindspots: map(filter(vars.techniques, not ((vars.state == 'deployed' or (vars.state == 'degraded' and not it.needs_driver)) and it.detected and (steps.ruleset.exists != true or contains(steps.ruleset.json.rules, it.id)))), it.id)
